claim_ceiling: Derived operational extension for probability semantics and system dynamics; not a truth layer or causal proof.

boundaries.probability_vs_causality: High probability is not causal strength or proof.
boundaries.posterior_vs_randomness: Posterior belief is not physical randomness.
boundaries.assumption_defaults: Markov, stationary, ergodic, linear, Gaussian, and closed-system assumptions must be declared.
boundaries.entropy: Information entropy and thermodynamic entropy are not merged.
boundaries.system_boundary: Boundary choices are observer/question-conditioned model choices.
